cases.title: Inter-VLAN Routing - Router Subinterface Down
cases.problem: PC0 cannot communicate with the server in VLAN 30.
symptoms: PC0 can ping its VLAN 10 gateway.
The VLAN 30 router subinterface is administratively down.

show_commands.show_ip_interface_brief: GigabitEthernet0/0.10 192.168.10.1 up up; GigabitEthernet0/0.30 192.168.30.1 administratively down down
show_commands.show_vlan_brief: VLAN 10 USERS: Fa0/1; VLAN 30 SERVERS: Fa0/2
show_commands.show_interfaces_trunk: Gig0/1 is trunking with 802.1q; VLANs 10,30 are allowed and active

cases.root_cause: GigabitEthernet0/0.30 is administratively shut down.
evidence: VLAN 30 exists and is active.
The trunk permits VLAN 30.
The VLAN 30 router subinterface is administratively down.
recommended_fix: enable
configure terminal
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.30
no shutdown
end
cases.expected_result: The subinterface becomes up/up and the server becomes reachable.

cases.title: Wrong VLAN Assignment
cases.problem: A user PC is connected to the wrong access VLAN.

show_commands.show_vlan_brief: VLAN 30 SERVERS: Fa0/1; VLAN 10 USERS: Fa0/2
show_commands.show_running_config: interface Fa0/1; switchport mode access; switchport access vlan 30

cases.root_cause: Fa0/1 is assigned to VLAN 30 instead of VLAN 10.
evidence: PC0 uses Fa0/1.
Fa0/1 is in VLAN 30.
The intended user VLAN is VLAN 10.
recommended_fix: enable
configure terminal
interface fastEthernet 0/1
switchport access vlan 10
end
cases.expected_result: Fa0/1 appears in VLAN 10 and PC0 regains VLAN 10 connectivity.

cases.title: Wrong Default Gateway
cases.problem: PC0 cannot reach a remote subnet.

show_commands.show_ip_interface_brief: GigabitEthernet0/0.10 192.168.10.1 up up; GigabitEthernet0/0.30 192.168.30.1 up up

cases.root_cause: PC0 has the wrong default gateway.
evidence: Correct gateway is 192.168.10.1.
Configured gateway is 192.168.10.254.
recommended_fix: Open PC0
Open Desktop > IP Configuration
Set Default Gateway to 192.168.10.1
cases.expected_result: PC0 can route traffic to remote networks.

cases.title: Wrong Server IP Address
cases.problem: Server is configured with an incorrect IP address.
symptoms: Connectivity or service behavior is inconsistent with the expected configuration.
cases.root_cause: The configuration is incorrect: 192.168.30.99.
evidence: show ip interface brief shows the faulty value: 192.168.30.99.
The expected value is: 192.168.30.10.
The symptom is consistent with this configuration fault.
recommended_fix: Correct the configuration from 192.168.30.99 to 192.168.30.10.
Save the corrected configuration after human review.
cases.expected_result: The configuration should show 192.168.30.10 and the affected service should work normally.
